name: Confederate States of America (Stars and Bars, 7 stars, 1861)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and red with a navy canton bearing a circle of seven white five-pointed stars.
history: The first version of the Confederate 'Stars and Bars', adopted on 4 March 1861 with seven stars for the seven states that had seceded by then: South Carolina, Mississippi, Florida, Alabama, Georgia, Louisiana and Texas. Stars were added as further states joined, reaching nine on 21 May 1861.
